title: Verifiable Intent Autonomous mode (three layers, agent delegated)
summary: The user signs open mandates with constraints and the agent key, then leaves. Later the agent signs L3a for the network and L3b for the merchant, bound to each other through checkout_hash and transaction_id. The network checks constraints and keeps state for budgets.

steps.label: Sign L2 Autonomous (kb-sd-jwt+kb)
steps.detail: Open mandates mandate.checkout.open.1 and mandate.payment.open.1 both carry the same agent cnf.jwk with kid, and constraints. The payment mandate must include mandate.payment.reference. Lifetime 24 hours to 30 days, never past L1 exp.

steps.label: Shop and get checkout_jwt
steps.detail: The agent shops within the constraints and receives a checkout_jwt from the merchant.

steps.label: Sign L3a and L3b
steps.detail: L3a holds mandate.payment.1 (aud: the network); L3b holds mandate.checkout.1 with checkout_hash and line_items (aud: the merchant). L3a transaction_id must equal L3b checkout_hash. Header kid matches L2 cnf.jwk.kid, no jwk header, no cnf in the payload. Lifetime 5 minutes recommended, 1 hour maximum.

steps.label: Present L1 + L2 + L3b
steps.detail: The merchant resolves the agent key from L2 by kid, checks typ, the selective sd_hash and the checkout constraints such as allowed merchants and line items.

steps.label: Present L1 + L2 + L3a
steps.detail: The network checks the payment constraints, enforces one L3 pair per mandate pair (or the agent_recurrence counters) and records cumulative spend.

failures.condition: cnf.jwk differs between the two L2 mandates

steps.label: Assurance data to issuer
steps.detail: The network returns assurance data; the issuer makes the final authorization decision.
